findings.highlight: Using a small connection like a blood vessel
findings.evidenceJa: 血液が流れるように、繋がった細い回路から
findings.governingReading: through a connected, slender circuit, as blood flows through a vessel
findings.explanation: The magical circuit carrying inaccessible memory becomes a generic small connection compared to a blood vessel.

findings.highlight: It’s so long ago that he doesn’t even recall it.[lr]It’s so old that he doesn’t even try to recall it.[lr]It’s so ancient that he cannot recall it.
findings.evidenceJa: 思い出す事もないほど昔の、[lr]思い出そうとする事もないほど遠い、[lr]思い出す事さえできなくなった古い記憶
findings.governingReading: an old memory so long past it is never recalled, so distant he never tries to recall it, and so old he has become unable even to recall it
findings.explanation: The progression from time, to emotional distance, to lost ability is reduced to three near-synonyms for age.

findings.highlight: A heavy burden of a contract
findings.evidenceJa: 決定してしまった契約の重い枷
findings.governingReading: the heavy shackle of a contract already irrevocably fixed
findings.explanation: The binding contract is a literalized shackle; the English generalizes it to a burden.

findings.highlight: the kind of guy that could not put up with anything
findings.evidenceJa: 我慢がならない質の人間
findings.governingReading: the sort of person unable to bear leaving suffering before him unanswered
findings.explanation: A disposition defined by the following suffering of others is overgeneralized into universal impatience.

findings.highlight: he would accomplish it in the end, and I think he changed a lot of people’s lives
findings.evidenceJa: 最後にはきちんと成し遂げて、その度に多くの人たちの運命を変えた
findings.governingReading: each time he properly carried it through in the end, changing the fates of many people
findings.explanation: The recurring success and alteration of fate are weakened into a tentative change to lives.

findings.highlight: I’m sure his life was a happy one.
findings.evidenceJa: 控えめに言っても、それは幸福よりだったろう
findings.governingReading: Even put conservatively, the result must have leaned toward happiness.
findings.explanation: A qualified assessment of the results of his rescues becomes certainty that his own life was happy.

findings.highlight: I shall give you my life after my death.
findings.governingReading: I entrust to you what comes after my death
findings.explanation: The contracted posthumous existence is rendered as the contradictory phrase “my life after my death.”

findings.highlight: I would like the compensation now.
findings.evidenceJa: その報酬を、ここに貰い受けたい
findings.governingReading: In return, I wish to receive the reward here and now.
findings.explanation: The explicit exchange and emphatic present location of the reward are weakened.
The Buddhist-inflected scope of beings to be saved is narrowed to people.
The exceptional social threat posed by a savior who stands out is weakened to ordinary excellence.
The metaphorical measure of what he can contain and accomplish becomes generic powers.

findings.governingReading: a narrow, cramped set of values
findings.explanation: A criticism of constricted perspective becomes an undefined “extreme value.”

findings.highlight: The way he silently pursued his ideal was something he should’ve been proud of.
findings.evidenceJa: それでも、無言で理想を追い続けたその姿は、胸を張っていいものだったのに
findings.governingReading: Even so, the figure who silently kept pursuing that ideal deserved to stand proud—yet it ended otherwise.
findings.explanation: The narrator’s concessive defense against others’ condemnation and regretful ending force are weakened.
The emotional and existential absence of requital is rendered as a transactional lack of compensation.

findings.highlight: He had friends and a lover.
findings.evidenceJa: 仲間らしきモノもいたし、恋人らしきモノもいた
findings.governingReading: He had things resembling companions and something resembling a lover.
findings.explanation: The dream’s deliberately distanced uncertainty is converted into definite relationships.

findings.highlight: He knew of his fate, but he acted like he tried to perform “miracles” using his fate as a support.
findings.evidenceJa: 死に行く運命を知っていながら、それを[ruby text=ささえ char=2]代償に
findings.governingReading: knowing he was fated to die, he used that fate as the price—and, in the ruby layer, the support
findings.explanation: The fate of death, the price paid, and the double-layered “support” reading collapse into vague fate used as support.

findings.highlight: he acted like he tried to perform “miracles”
findings.evidenceJa: 己が手に余る“奇蹟”を成し遂げようとするように
findings.governingReading: as though striving to accomplish a “miracle” beyond his own capacity
findings.explanation: A singular impossible achievement and sustained resolve become awkwardly tentative plural miracle-performing.

findings.highlight: he lets go of the sword
findings.evidenceJa: 崩れ落ちるように、剣から手を放した
findings.governingReading: he releases his hand from the sword as though collapsing
findings.explanation: The physical collapse accompanying the final release disappears.
